opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC member (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting; hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports RSC members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Provides up to £5000 for 12 months for chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting and for the grant duration. PhD students or researchers at any career stage, any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations. Funds research visits to collaborators' institutions and organising meetings/workshops. 2026 Round 2 open 3 August to 21 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: You are a chemist; based in UK or Ireland (or hold valid RSC membership for minimum 3 consecutive years if outside); will incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related event; have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event, covering additional costs of care that the applicant usually provides. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: You are a chemist; based in UK or Ireland (or hold valid RSC membership for minimum 3 consecutive years if outside); will use funds to cover support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event; have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to reduce accessibility challenges when attending professional events, covering costs such as accessible travel/accommodation, personal assistance, communication support, assistive software/hardware for people with disabilities and health conditions. Supported by the Chemists' Community Fund.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account), or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; not resubmit an unsuccessful application unless invited; project must have a significant chemical sciences aspect.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences, including building chemists' engagement skills, engaging school students and public audiences, and providing under-represented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines (6 March, 5 June, 2 October 2026); final deadline 2 October 2026.
